card.name: Hyphen or apostrophe joins inside compounds
card.fires_on: Short joining pieces such as a hyphen plus a letter or two (-re, -c, -ROM, -on) or a possessive 's after a noun, in general web text. The marked piece sits in the middle of a compound or just before the rest of a word.

modes.label: Hyphen joins in compounds
modes.description: A hyphen with a short piece inside a hyphenated compound, often split so the word continues after it.
modes.example: Is the generation of children growing up now prepared for hardship, sacrifice, and self<<-re>>liance?

modes.label: Possessive 's after a noun
modes.description: An apostrophe-s after a person or title, followed by the thing owned.
modes.example: where the Saint<<'s>> holy relics are located.

card.plain: It marks the small joint in a hyphenated or possessive word, where the word is not finished yet.
